result.reason: The operative clause fully satisfies the preferred package and therefore also the fallback limits. It is not minimal because it additionally requires coverage at Licensor's expense and extends the principal insurance obligations for one year after the agreement term, neither of which was required by either position. The added clause does not alter the existing representation-by-counsel language or contradict the requested insurance terms. Drafting is generally clear, but the post-term requirement is overbroad—particularly for occurrence-based CGL coverage—and “Licensee data” should track any defined Customer Data term to avoid ambiguity.
